summary: One serum remains. Levi chooses Armin over Erwin. The choice does not feel like dawn. It feels like a sun that refuses to set on either death.

segments.ja: 戦闘のあと、屋根の上に二つの瀕死が並びます。並ぶ一人は、アルミンです。もう一人は、エルヴィンです。エルヴィンは、突撃の石で落ちた団長です。団長を、フロックが瓦礫から運んできます。運んできた事実が、選択を避けられなくします。避けられない理由は、血清が一つだからです。一つの注射で、戻せる人間は一人です。一人を選ぶことが、白夜の全部です。
segments.en: After the fight, two near-deaths line up on the roof. One of the people who line up is Armin. The other is Erwin. Erwin is the Commander who fell to a stone of the charge. Floch carries the Commander out of the rubble. The fact he carried him makes the choice unavoidable. The reason it is unavoidable is that the serum is one. With one injection, the human who can be returned is one. Choosing one person is the whole of the midnight sun.

segments.ja: 血清は、薬のように傷を閉じません。閉じない代わりに、打たれた人間を巨人へ変えます。変えた巨人が、力を持つ人間を食べることで、その力を継ぎます。継ぐ相手として、ベルトルトがまだ生きています。生きているベルトルトは、超大型の力の器です。器を、アルミンに継がせる案と、エルヴィンに継がせる案が同時にあります。同時にあることが、友情と兵団を対立させます。対立は、どちらかを殺す選択です。
segments.en: The serum does not close a wound like a medicine. Instead of closing it, it changes the injected human into a Titan. The Titan it changed inherits that power by eating a human who holds a power. As the opponent to inherit from, Bertholdt is still alive. The living Bertholdt is the vessel of the Colossal's power. There is at the same time a plan to let Armin inherit the vessel and a plan to let Erwin inherit it. Being there at the same time sets friendship against the corps. The opposition is a choice that kills one of them.

segments.ja: エレンは、血清をアルミンに使うよう求めます。求める理由は、海を見る約束です。約束は、作戦の効率ではありません。効率より、彼は友人の未来を残します。残す主張を、ミカサが同じ側で支えます。支える刃は、ここでは命令に向きます。向く相手は、血清を持つリヴァイです。リヴァイは、団長を戻す側の責任を持っています。持っている責任と、目の前の二人の懇願が衝突します。
segments.en: Eren asks that the serum be used on Armin. The reason he asks is the promise to see the sea. The promise is not the efficiency of an operation. Ahead of efficiency, he leaves his friend's future. Mikasa supports on the same side the claim he leaves. The blade that supports turns here toward an order. The opponent it turns toward is Levi, who holds the serum. Levi holds the responsibility of the side that would return the Commander. The responsibility he holds collides with the plea of the two people in front of him.

segments.en: Floch says Erwin should be returned. The reason he says it is that a devil is necessary. The content of necessary is that for humanity to survive outside the walls, the Commander's cruelty is needed. He places the claim that is needed as the representative of the survivors. The voice he places is young. The young voice has seen the annihilation of the flat ground. The annihilation he has seen is the ground of his word devil. The ground is that Armin's gentleness did not stop the stones.

segments.ja: ハンジは、両方の顔を知っています。知っている顔のどちらも、失いたくありません。失いたくない気持ちが、決断を遅らせます。遅らせるあいだに、ベルトルトの意識が戻る危険があります。ある危険を、彼女は研究者として測ります。測っても、友人としては針を選べません。選べない隊長の代わりに、針はリヴァイの手にあります。ある手が、白夜の決定権です。決定権は、正義の役職ではありません。
segments.en: Hange knows both faces. She does not want to lose either of the faces she knows. The feeling of not wanting to lose delays the decision. While it delays, there is a danger that Bertholdt's consciousness returns. She measures the danger that is there as a researcher. Even measuring, as a friend she cannot choose the needle. In place of the section commander who cannot choose, the needle is in Levi's hand. The hand that is there is the right of decision of the midnight sun. The right of decision is not an office of justice.

segments.ja: リヴァイは、エルヴィンの顔を見ます。見る顔は、地下室の仮説に人生を賭けた顔です。賭けた人生が、今、石で途切れています。途切れた体に血清を打てば、団長は巨人としてベルトルトを食べることになります。食べる未来を、彼は兵団の継続として一度は持ちます。持つ未来を、エレンの叫びが揺さぶります。揺さぶる叫びは、アルミンを殺せ、という拒否です。拒否を、兵長は感情としては切ります。切っても、針はすぐには下りません。
segments.en: Levi looks at Erwin's face. The face he looks at is a face that bet a life on the hypothesis of the basement. The life that was bet is now cut off by a stone. If he injects the serum into the cut-off body, the Commander will eat Bertholdt as a Titan. He once holds the future of eating as the continuation of the corps. Eren's shout shakes the future he holds. The shout that shakes is a refusal that says do not kill Armin. As a feeling, the Captain cuts the refusal. Even cutting it, the needle does not come down at once.

segments.ja: 瀕死のエルヴィンは、父の問いを夢に見ます。見る問いは、壁の外を知れ、という子供の日の続きです。続きを、彼はもう自分の足では追えません。追えなくても、夢の中の手はまだ伸びます。伸びる手を、リヴァイは見ています。見ている兵長は、団長を地獄の質問から降ろす選択を考えます。考える選択は、血清を使わない、です。使わないことが、休息です。休息を、フロックは敗北と呼びます。
segments.en: Erwin near death sees his father's question in a dream. The question he sees is the continuation of a childhood day: know the outside of the walls. He can no longer chase the continuation with his own feet. Even unable to chase it, the hand in the dream still reaches. Levi is watching the hand that reaches. The Captain who is watching considers a choice to take the Commander down from the hell of the question. The choice he considers is not to use the serum. Not using it is rest. Floch calls the rest a defeat.

segments.en: In the end, Levi points the needle at Armin. He does not make the reason he points it into a long speech. The core of the choice he does not make into a speech is: do not return the Commander to any further hell. Not returning him is a shape of loyalty. The shape differs from Floch's devil. Eren and Mikasa receive the different shape with relief. The relief they receive is not a victory. It is returning one friend by a Titan's power. The price of returning is Bertholdt.

segments.ja: 血清を打たれたアルミンは、巨人となり、ベルトルトを食べます。食べる行為は、英雄の延長ではありません。延長ではなく、力の継承です。継承のあと、超大型の力はアルミンの中に移ります。移る光景を、エレンは目を逸らせません。逸らせない理由は、自分が隙を作るために友人を焼かせた、です。焼かせた友人が、今、別の友人を食べることになります。ことになる連鎖が、白夜の光です。光は、優しい朝ではありません。
segments.en: Armin, injected with the serum, becomes a Titan and eats Bertholdt. The act of eating is not an extension of the hero. It is not an extension. It is an inheritance of power. After the inheritance, the Colossal's power moves inside Armin. Eren cannot look away from the scene that moves. The reason he cannot look away is that he had his friend burned in order to make a gap. The friend he had burned now comes to eat another friend. The chain of coming to that is the light of the midnight sun. The light is not a kind morning.

Inside the disposal they treat, the memory of three years of meals remains. Nobody makes the memory that remains into words of mourning. Without making it, only the power moves to Armin. segments.titleJa: エルヴィンは戻らない
segments.ja: エルヴィンは、血清を受けずに死にます。死ぬことが、質問の地獄からの離脱です。離脱を、リヴァイは自分の選択として背負います。背負う選択を、フロックは許しません。許さない声が、後の季節の種です。種は、今日はまだ小さいです。小さい種の横で、団長の体は静かに置かれます。置かれた体は、もう名簿を更新しません。更新しないことが、調査兵団の時代の区切りです。
segments.en: Erwin dies without receiving the serum. Dying is a departure from the hell of the question. Levi carries the departure as his own choice. Floch does not forgive the choice he carries. The voice that does not forgive is a seed of a later season. The seed is still small today. Beside the small seed, the Commander's body is placed quietly. The placed body no longer updates the roster. Not updating is the break in the era of the Survey Corps.

segments.titleJa: アルミンは目を開ける
segments.ja: 食べたあとのアルミンは、人間の姿で目を開けます。開ける目は、自分が何をしたかをまだ全部は持っていません。持っていない空白を、エレンとミカサが埋めます。埋める言葉は、生きていてよかった、に近いです。近い言葉の下に、ベルトルトを食べた事実があります。ある事実を、彼は後で自分の罪として受け取ります。受け取る前に、今日は生存だけが確認されます。確認が、白夜の終わりの薄明です。
segments.en: After eating, Armin opens his eyes in a human form. The eyes he opens do not yet hold everything of what he did. Eren and Mikasa fill the blank he does not hold. The words that fill it are close to it is good that you are alive. Under the words that are close, there is the fact that he ate Bertholdt. He receives later the fact that is there as his own sin. Before he receives it, today only survival is confirmed. The confirmation is the thin light at the end of the midnight sun.

segments.en: Even after the choice ends, Eren's house has not been opened. The door that has not been opened is the next episode of the basement. Before the episode, the survivors count the dead. The number they count is the perfect game on the flat ground, the closeness of the thunder spears, and the Commander. The corps that lost the Commander still goes to open the page. The reason they go is that even if Erwin dies, the hypothesis remains. Hange receives the hypothesis that remains as the next responsibility. The responsibility she receives is after the midnight sun.
